title: Burnout stun: pool, jump kick and repeat pool
summary: Use the stun window to apply a poison pool before the jump-in and spend OD Lash plus one Rush on a new pool finish.
notation: 214MP > 9 > j.HK > st.MK > st.MP > 236MP > st.HK > 236PP > 214HP > Drive Rush > st.HK > 2PP > P > 214MP
conditions: Prerequisite: Ryu is already stunned by a Burnout wall Impact. The prerequisite DI is outside this loop and its Drive cost is not included.
